question_cn: 象马对王被认为是最难的基本残局，主要原因是：
question_en: Bishop and knight vs. king is considered the hardest basic endgame. The main reason is:

options.text_cn: 象马不能配合，无法将死
options.text_en: Bishop and knight can't cooperate and can't checkmate

options.text_cn: 需要把对方王赶到特定颜色的角落，步骤复杂
options.text_en: Must drive the enemy king to a specific corner color — the procedure is complex
The bishop or knight will be captured

options.text_cn: 只有50步规则限制，时间不够
options.text_en: Only the 50-move rule is the issue, not enough time

explanation_cn: 象马残局难在路径：必须用马引导，把对方王赶离异色角、逼向同色角，再精确配合将杀。这需要完整的象马Malketu技法，步骤多、容易出错。
explanation_en: The difficulty: you must guide the enemy king from the wrong-color corner to the right-color corner using precise knight maneuvers, then deliver checkmate.
